L107@P4: There shall be no such defects as scratch, rust, discoloration, leakage which may adversely

L109@P4: 6. Standard Test Conditions
L110@P4: 6.1 Environmental Conditions
L111@P4: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are conducted at
L112@P4: temperature 23±3℃(@RT) and humidity under 65%.
L113@P4: 6.2 Measuring Equipment
L114@P4: (1) Amp-meter and Volt-meter
L115@P4: The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.5mA and
L116@P4: mV or higher.
L117@P4: (2) Slide caliper
L118@P4: The slide caliper should have 0.01 mm scale.
L119@P4: (3) Impedance meter
L120@P4: The impedance meter with AC 1kHz should be used.
L121@P4: 7. Characteristics
L122@P4: 7.1 Standard Charge
L123@P4: This "Standard Charge" means charging Cell with charge current of 0.5C (2,450mA)
L124@P4: and constant voltage 4.2V and 0.02C(98mA) cut-off in CV mode at 23℃ for capacity.
L125@P4: 7.2 Standard Discharge Capacity
L126@P4: The standard discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of Cell, which is
L127@P4: measured with discharge current of 0.2C(980mA) with 2.50V cut-off at 23°C within 1
L128@P4: hour after the Standard charge.
L129@P4: Standard Discharge Capacity ≥ 4,900mAh
L130@P4: 7.3 Rated Discharge Capacity
L131@P4: The rated discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of Cell, which is measured
L132@P4: with discharge current of 1C(4,900mA) with 2.50V cut-off at 23°C within 1 hour after
L133@P4: the Standard charge.
L134@P4: Rated Discharge Capacity ≥ 4,753mAh (97% of 4,900mAh)

L136@P4: Initial internal impedance measured at AC 1kHz after Standard charge.

L235@P12: Proper Use and Handling of Lithium Ion Cells
L236@P12: See before using lithium-ion cell
L237@P12: This document has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and prohibitions, which
L238@P12: the customer should take or employ when the customer uses and handles the lithium ion cell
L239@P12: to be manufactured and supplied by Samsung SDI in order to obtain optimum performance
L240@P12: and safety.
L241@P12: 1. Charging
L242@P12: 1.1 Charging current
L243@P12: Charging current should be less than maximum charge current specified in the product
L244@P12: specification.
L245@P12: 1.2 Charging voltage
L246@P12: Charging should be done by voltage less than that specified in the product
L247@P12: specification.
L248@P12: 1.3 Charging time
L249@P12: Continuous charging under specified voltage does not cause any loss of performance
L250@P12: characteristics. However, the charge timer is recommended to be installed from a
L251@P12: safety consideration, which shuts off further charging at time specified in the product
L252@P12: specification.
L253@P12: 1.4 Charging temperature
L254@P12: Cell should be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the specification.
L255@P12: 1.5 Reverse charging
L256@P12: Cell should be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned. Inverse
L257@P12: charging should be strictly prohibited. If Cell is connected improperly, it may be
L258@P12: damaged.
L259@P12: 2. Discharging
L260@P12: 2.1 Discharging
L261@P12: Cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharge current specified
L262@P12: in the product specification. In case of the higher discharge current should be set, it
L263@P12: shall be discussed together with SDI.
L264@P12: 2.2 Discharging temperature
L265@P12: 2.2.1 Cell should be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in the product
L266@P12: specification.
L267@P12: 2.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics.
L268@P12: 2.3 Over-discharging
L269@P12: 2.3.1 The system should be equipped with a device to prevent further discharging
L270@P12-13: exceeding discharging cut-off voltage specified in the product specification.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L271@P13: Spec. No. INR21700-50G Version No. V1.0
L272@P13: 13
L273@P13: 2.3.2 Over-discharging may cause loss of performance, characteristics of battery
L274@P13: function.
L275@P13: 2.3.3 Over-discharging may occur by self-discharge if the battery is left for a very long
L276@P13: time without any use.
L277@P13: 2.3.4 The charger should be equipped with a device to detect Cell voltage and to
L278@P13: determine recharging procedures.
L279@P13: 3. Storage
L280@P13: 3.1 Storage conditions
L281@P13: 3.1.1 Cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified as below*4
L282@P13: *4 Store the battery at 0 ~ 23℃, low humidity (below 65%), no dust and no
L283@P13: corrosive gas atmosphere
L284@P13: 3.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L285@P13: 3.2 Long-term storage
L286@P13: 3.2.1 Cell should be used within a short period after charging because long-term
L287@P13: storage may cause loss of capacity by self-discharging.
L288@P13: 3.2.2 If long-term (but not longer than Warranty Period as set forth in Section 10
L289@P13: (Warranty)) storage is necessary, Cell shall be stored at shipping voltage, because
L290@P13: storage with higher voltage may cause more loss of performance characteristics.
L291@P13: 3.3 Storage period
L292@P13: Samsung SDI shall not be liable for any defects of Cell after Warranty Period even if
L293@P13: Cell is stored in accordance with Sections 3.1 and 3.2 above.
L294@P13: 4. Cycle life
L295@P13: 4.1 Cycle life performance
L296@P13: 4.1.1 Cell can be charged/discharged repeatedly up to times specified in the produce
L297@P13: specification with a certain level of capacity also specified in the product
L298@P13: specification.
L299@P13: 4.1.2 Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging, operating
L300@P13: temperature and/or storage.
L301@P13: 5. Battery Pack Assembly
L302@P13: 5.1 Prohibition of usage of damaged Cell
L303@P13: 5.1.1 Cell should be inspected visually before battery assembly.
L304@P13: 5.1.2 Cell should not be used if sleeve-damage, can-distortion and/or electrolyte-smell
L305@P13: is detected.
L306@P13: 5.2 Terminals handling
L307@P13: 5.2.1 Excessive force on the negative terminal should be avoided when external strip
L308@P13: terminal is welled.
L309@P13: 5.3 Transportation
L310@P13-14: 5.3.1 If Cell is necessary to be transported to such as the battery manufacturer, careful SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L311@P14: Spec. No. INR21700-50G Version No. V1.0
L312@P14: 14
L313@P14: precautions should be taken to avoid damage of Cell.
L314@P14: 6. Others
L315@P14: 6.1 Disassembly
L316@P14: 6.1.1 Cell should not be dismantled from the battery pack.
L317@P14: 6.1.2 Internal short-circuit caused by disassembly may lead to heat generation and/or
L318@P14: venting.
L319@P14: 6.1.3 When the electrolyte is coming in contact with the skin or eyes, wash
L320@P14: immediately with fresh water and seek medical advice.
L321@P14: 6.2 Short-circuiting
L322@P14: 6.2.1 Short-circuit results in very high current which leads to heat generation.
L323@P14: 6.2.2 An appropriate circuitry should be employed to protect accidental short-circuiting.
L324@P14: 6.3 Incineration
L325@P14: 6.3.1 Incinerating and disposing of Cell in fire are strictly prohibited, because it may
L326@P14: cause rupture and explosion.
L327@P14: 6.4 Immersion
L328@P14: 6.4.1 Soaking Cell in water is strictly prohibited, because it may cause corrosion and
L329@P14: leakage of components to be damaged to functions.
L330@P14: 6.5 Mixing use
L331@P14: 6.5.1 Different types of Cell, or same types but different Cell manufacturer's shall not
L332@P14: be used, which may lead to Cell imbalance, Cell rupture or damage to system due
L333@P14: to the different characteristics of Cell.
L334@P14: 6.5.2 Do not mix use Cells from different batches/ranks even they are the same Cell
L335@P14: types from the same manufacturer.
L336@P14: 6.6 Battery disposal
L337@P14: 6.6.1 Although Cell contains no environmentally hazardous component, such as lead or
L338@P14: cadmium. the battery should be disposed according to the local regulations when
L339@P14: it is disposed.
L340@P14: 6.6.2 Cell should be disposed with a discharged state to avoid heat generation by an
L341@P14: inadvertent short-circuit.
L342@P14: 6.7 Caution
L343@P14: 6.7.1 The Battery used in this device may present a risk of fire or chemical burn if
L344@P14: mistreated.
L345@P14: 6.7.2 Do not disassemble, expose to heat above 100℃ or incinerate it.
L346@P14: 6.7.3 Replace battery with Samsung SDI battery only.
L347@P14: 6.7.4 Use of another battery may present a risk of fire or explosion.
L348@P14: 6.7.5 Dispose of used battery promptly.
L349@P14: 6.7.6 Keep away from children.
L350@P14-15: 6.7.7 Do not disassemble and do not dispose of in fire.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L351@P15: Spec. No. INR21700-50G Version No. V1.0

L353@P15: Pack Design Guideline for Lithium Ion Cells
L354@P15: If a customer’s battery pack cannot meet Pack Design Guideline below, SDI shall
L355@P15: not be responsible for any quality issues arising out of or in connection with Cell.
L356@P15: 1. Electrical design
L357@P15: 1.1 Charge
L358@P15: 1.1.1 Stop charging the battery if charging isn't completed within the specified time.
L359@P15: 1.1.2 The battery can be used within the following temperature ranges.
L360@P15: Don't exceed these ranges.
L361@P15: Charge temperature ranges : 0℃ ~ 45℃
L362@P15: 1.1.3 Charge current must be controlled by specified value in Cell specification.
L363@P15: 1.1.4 Cut-off Voltage of charging must be 4.2V.
L364@P15: 1.1.5 Charger must stop charging battery by detecting either charging time or current
L365@P15: specified in Cell specification.
L366@P15: 1.1.6 Recharge Voltage must be at least 0.1V lower than Max charging Voltage.
L367@P15: 1.1.7 Do not charge the battery under 1.0V voltage.
L368@P15: 1.1.8 Voltage range of the battery for pre-charge mode is 1.0 ~ 3.0V with a charging
L369@P15: current of 0.1 ~ 0.5C.
L370@P15: 1.2 Discharge
L371@P15: 1.2.1 Discharge current must be controlled by specified value in Cell specification.
L372@P15: 1.2.2 Cut-off Voltage of discharging must be over 2.5V.
L373@P15: 1.2.3 The battery can be used within the following temperature ranges.
L374@P15: Don't exceed these ranges.
L375@P15: Discharge temperature ranges : -20℃ ~ 60℃
L376@P15: 1.3 Storage
L377@P15: Store the battery at low temperature (below 60℃, 20℃ is recommended), low humidity
L378@P15: (below 65%), no dust and no corrosive gas atmosphere.
L379@P15: 1.4 Design of positioning the battery pack in application and charger
L380@P15: To prevent the deterioration of the battery performance caused by heat, battery shall be
L381@P15: positioned away from the area where heat is generated in the application and the
L382@P15: charger.
L383@P15: 1.5 Safety Device
L384@P15: Be sure adopting proper safe device such as PTC specified type or model in Cell
L385@P15: Specification. If you intend to adopt different safety device which is not specified in Cell
L386@P15: Specification, please contact Samsung SDI to investigate any potential safety problem.
L387@P15: Be sure designing 2nd protective devices such as PTC & PCM at the same time to protect
L388@P15: Cell just in case one protective device is fault.
L389@P15: 2. Design of System
L390@P15: 2.1 Connection between Cells and the battery
L391@P15: 2.1.1 Cell should not be soldered directly with other Cells. Namely, Cell should be welded
